description_en: Queries the storage usage of a Bastionhost instance
description_zh: 查询堡垒机实例存储空间的使用情况
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost get-instance-store-info --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetInstanceStoreInfo

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

Max.description_en: The maximum storage capacity of the current Bastionhost instance. Unit: bytes
Max.description_zh: 当前堡垒机实例存储空间最大容量。单位：Byte

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Usage.description_en: The used storage capacity of the current Bastionhost instance. Unit: bytes
Usage.description_zh: 当前堡垒机实例存储空间已使用容量。单位：Byte
